cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.4.4.0)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS [[--no-default-config -fno-blocks -resource-dir "/Users/rmanaloto/.local/state/marketplace-tool-foundation/p2996-configure-20261011T051205Z/prefix/lib/clang/21"]])
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_C_LINK_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_C_LINK_FLAGS_Debug "")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v -Wl,-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0214 NEW)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/Users/rmanaloto/.local/state/marketplace-tool-foundation/p2996-cmake-20261011T120831Z/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-Rlxtzl")
add_executable(cmTC_fafaa)
target_sources(cmTC_fafaa PRIVATE
  "/Users/rmanaloto/.local/share/mise/installs/cmake/4.4.4/cmake-4.4.4-macos-universal/CMake.app/Contents/share/cmake-4.4/Modules/CMakeCCompilerABI.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_fafaa_$<UPPER_CASE:$<CONFIG>>_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_fafaa>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_fafaa ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
